items.title: Researcher, Agent Safety, Training and Evaluations
items.description: About the Team The Agent Safety team works to ensure that increasingly capable AI agents act safely, exercise sound judgment, and remain aligned with user intent. Our mission is to reduce the probability of severe unintended outcomes from increasingly capable AI agents while preserving their ability to act effectively and autonomously. Our work spans three areas: - Training: Create training methods, environments and data that teach agents to make better decisions in consequential situations. We turn real-world failures into training signals that prevent similar incidents, and identify precursor behaviors and mitigations to address emerging risks. - Measurements: Build evaluations and production metrics that identify emerging risks and measure whether our interventions work. - Oversight: Develop oversight and system mitigation mechanisms that reduce harmful actions while preserving useful autonomy (for example future versions of auto-review https://alignment.openai.com/auto-review/). About the Role We’re looking for strong executors with excellent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and an understanding of frontier model research. You don’t need prior safety or alignment experience, we also welcome people that recently realized that alignment and safety is a critical area to contribute to. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Train and evaluate frontier models to reduce harmful or misaligned agent actions, forming clear hypotheses and executing independently through ambiguity. - Mine incidents and build scalable measurement, data-processing, and evaluation systems that turn real failures into repeatable safety signals. - Collaborate closely with post-training, capabilities, oversight, and pre-training partners to ship research-backed mitigations into large-scale training and agent systems. items.title: Research Engineer, ML Platform
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE This role focuses on building and operating the ML platform that powers large-scale training, evaluation, and batch inference at Mistral AI. You will develop the infrastructure that enables researchers and engineers to run distributed GPU workloads reliably across clusters, hardware types, and regions. You will work across the full ML lifecycle, from workload scheduling and capacity management to platform APIs, observability, and production operations. You will take ownership of critical systems and help turn complex infrastructure into reliable, self-service capabilities. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Build the ML Platform: Develop services, APIs, controllers, and tooling for training, evaluation, fine-tuning, and batch inference. - Orchestrate GPU Workloads: Build systems for queueing, admission control, quotas, priorities, preemption, and topology-aware placement. - Manage Compute Capacity: Improve how heterogeneous GPU resources are provisioned, allocated, and utilized across clusters. - Enable Multi-Cluster Execution: Place workloads based on capacity, data locality, hardware requirements, and organizational priorities. - Improve Researcher Experience: Create self-service workflows that make distributed workloads easy to launch, observe, debug, and reproduce. - Optimize Performance: Improve GPU utilization, scheduling latency, workload startup time, throughput, and infrastructure efficiency. - Build for Reliability: Develop observability, failure recovery, capacity planning, and operational tooling for critical ML workloads. - Operate What You Build: Participate in on-call rotations and troubleshoot issues across applications, schedulers, networking, storage, and GPU infrastructure. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Have 4+ years of experience in ML infrastructure, distributed systems, Kubernetes platform engineering, or a related field. - Are proficient in Python or Go and comfortable working with production-grade distributed systems. - Have strong Kubernetes knowledge, including controllers, operators, CRDs, scheduling, networking, storage, and resource management. - Understand technologies such as Kueue, Karpenter, Volcano, and Kyverno, and the problems they address in workload scheduling, provisioning, and policy enforcement. - Understand distributed ML workloads, including training, fine-tuning, evaluation, checkpointing, and batch inference. - Are familiar with GPU infrastructure and technologies such as PyTorch, CUDA, NCCL, and high-performance networking. - Understand concepts such as quotas, priorities, preemption, gang scheduling, topology awareness, and workload admission. - Can diagnose performance and reliability problems across software, orchestration, networking, storage, and hardware. - Care about developer experience and enjoy turning complex infrastructure into simple, reliable interfaces. - Thrive in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment shaped by frontier AI research. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. items.title: AML Investigator
items.location_text: Denver, CO; New York, NY; Westlake, TX
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Financial Crimes Investigations team protects Robinhood and its customers by detecting, investigating, and reporting potentially suspicious activity across our brokerage and crypto products. The team partners closely with Compliance, Legal, Product, Risk, and Engineering to strengthen controls and meet regulatory obligations. We focus on thorough investigations, clear documentation, and continuous process improvement to reduce financial crime risk. Our work directly supports regulatory compliance and customer trust. As a Crypto AML Investigator, you will conduct complex investigations involving cryptocurrency transactions, brokerage accounts, and cash movement. You will analyze blockchain activity using industry-standard analytics tools, evaluate customer behavior across Robinhood entities, and prepare Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) that meet regulatory requirements. You will manage investigations from initial alert through final decision and documentation, while identifying trends and control enhancements that strengthen our monitoring program. Your analysis will contribute directly to meeting Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and anti-money laundering (AML) obligations. This role is based in our New York, NY; Denver, CO; or Westlake, TX office(s)office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Conduct investigations into potentially suspicious activity across cryptocurrency products, brokerage accounts, and fiat transactions generated from transaction monitoring systems, referrals, or external inquiries. Analyze blockchain transactions using tools such as Chainalysis, TRM, or similar platforms to trace fund flows and identify indicators of money laundering or other financial crimes. Review customer activity across Robinhood Financial, Robinhood Securities, Robinhood Crypto, and Robinhood Money to assess risk and determine appropriate case outcomes. Draft clear, well-supported Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) that meet regulatory standards and internal quality benchmarks. Manage the full lifecycle of investigations, including alert review, evidence gathering, decisioning, documentation, and case closure. Contribute to process improvements by identifying trends, control gaps, or tooling enhancements that improve investigative quality and efficiency. What you bring 2+ years of AML investigation experience within a broker-dealer, cryptocurrency firm, fintech company, or financial institution, including SAR drafting. Hands-on experience analyzing cryptocurrency transactions and using blockchain analytics platforms (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM, or similar tools). Preference for those with course certifications from Chainalysis or TRM Experience working across both fiat and crypto product environments Strong understanding of BSA/AML regulatory requirements, particularly as they relate to virtual currencies and digital asset platforms. Ability to evaluate large data sets, document findings clearly, and make defensible risk-based decisions. Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preference for those with ACAMS certification or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) designation. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $74,000 — $87,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $65,000 — $77,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $58,000 — $68,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

Develop and execute region-specific prospecting strategies that account for local market dynamics, cultural nuances, and competitive landscapes across diverse European markets Support all sales We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.description: As an Engineering Manager – Platform Engineering , you will lead engineering teams responsible for the platforms, tooling and capabilities that enable application teams to build, deploy, observe and operate their software reliably. You will lead approximately 10–12 engineers across Delivery and Observability, working closely with Tech Leads, Architects, application engineering teams and other Engineering Leaders to set direction, prioritise improvements and ensure the platform delivers reliable and effective capabilities to its users. This is a technically strong engineering leadership role . While you won't be expected to code day-to-day, you should be comfortable reviewing technical changes, challenging engineering decisions, understanding technical risks and participating in production incidents. You will also be accountable for the overall performance, stability and operational health of the domain, ensuring platform services meet agreed SLAs/SLOs, reducing incidents and continuously improving the experience for the engineering teams that depend on them. A taster of what you will be involved with Own roadmap and delivery – Drive prioritisation, planning and execution across the domain, balancing platform improvements, operational commitments and organisational priorities. Lead and develop high-performing teams – Build the right team structure, skills and culture while owning recruitment, performance, career development and succession planning. Drive technical excellence – Partner with Tech Leads and Architects to challenge technical decisions, manage risks and ensure platform solutions are reliable, secure and maintainable. Own platform performance and stability – Monitor SLAs/SLOs, service health and engineering metrics, driving continuous improvement, reducing incidents and improving reliability. Lead operational excellence – Ensure operational readiness, observability, incident management and effective RCA, acting as an escalation point for major incidents and ensuring preventative actions are delivered. Partner across the organisation – Work with application engineering teams, Architects and Engineering Leaders to understand needs, manage expectations, remove blockers and continuously improve platform capabilities and ways of working. What we’re looking for Strong technical background with the ability to understand complex systems, review changes and challenge technical decisions. Experience leading and developing engineering teams, including recruitment, performance and career development. Strong roadmap, prioritisation and delivery management skills, with accountability for quality and timelines. Experience working with Tech Leads, Architects, Product and engineering stakeholders. Good understanding of platform engineering, cloud, CI/CD, automation and Infrastructure as Code. Strong understanding of observability, reliability and production operations. Experience managing SLAs/SLOs, service performance and operational metrics, with a focus on improving stability and reducing incidents. Strong communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills, with a pragmatic and outcome-focused approach. Nice to have Experience managing teams responsible for CI/CD, developer platforms, engineering tooling or software delivery platforms. Experience managing Observability, SRE or Platform Reliability teams. Experience with AWS or other major cloud platforms. Familiarity with technologies such as Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or similar tooling. Who We Are Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960’s. We’re Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta. We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands. You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers! Product Development at Betsson Group Our Product Development organisation is truly Global with cross functional teams spanning 6 Tech Hubs – Malta, Budapest, Stockholm, Tallinn, Malaga and Athens. With around 1,000 strong professionals, the Product Development organisation is spear-headed by our CTO-CPO with all our talented Area Teams working together. Challenge accepted? items.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Services
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE The exchange is the core of what Polymarket does. Every trade, every order, every market resolution runs through the systems this team owns. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Services team, you'll be working directly on that infrastructure, building and scaling the backend that processes real money, in real time, at meaningful volume. The work is technical, high-stakes, and unambiguous in its consequences. This is an individual contributor role with high autonomy and high ownership. You'll work alongside a small group of senior engineers who care deeply about correctness and performance. There's no heavy process here, no committees, no long approval chains. You'll be expected to identify problems, propose solutions, and ship them. The mandate is simple: keep the exchange fast, correct, and available as Polymarket continues to scale. If you've spent your career building systems where performance actually matters, where a bug in production has real consequences, this is the kind of problem you've been waiting to work on. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and implement low-latency backend services that power Polymarket's core exchange, primarily in Go, with Python or Java where appropriate. - Profile and tune systems across the full stack, identifying bottlenecks in latency, throughput, and memory usage before they become production problems. - Build and maintain event-driven data pipelines and APIs using streaming platforms like Kafka or Pulsar, ensuring data moves reliably and quickly across the exchange. - Own production reliability for the systems you build, including diagnosing live incidents, writing postmortems, and shipping fixes that prevent recurrence. - Work directly with engineers across product, infrastructure, and data to integrate exchange services tightly with the broader platform. - Contribute to architectural decisions on distributed systems design, with a focus on failure modes, graceful degradation, and recovery under partial outages. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 7+ years of professional backend development experience, with strong proficiency in Go, Python, or Java. Go experience is a significant advantage. - Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and memory management, with a track record of applying that knowledge to real production systems. - Experience building and debugging high-throughput, low-latency systems on Linux end-to-end, from design through to production operation. - Strong instincts for correctness, especially in systems where failures have financial consequences. You write defensively, think about edge cases early, and treat bugs in prod as a serious matter. - Comfortable working independently in a high-autonomy environment. You identify what needs to be done and do it without waiting to be unblocked. - (Plus) Experience in trading systems, high-frequency trading, gaming, telecom, or any domain where latency is a hard constraint, not a stretch goal. - (Plus) Production experience with Kafka, Pulsar, or similar streaming platforms at meaningful scale. - (Plus) Familiarity with gRPC, Protobuf, or ZeroMQ. - (Plus) Experience deploying and operating services in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, using containers and modern deployment tooling. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.title: HPC Infrastructure Engineer - GPU Clusters
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE Every model we train runs on infrastructure this role owns. We operate NVIDIA GPU clusters across bare metal and rented capacity, and we're looking for an engineer to join our small research infrastructure team and make that compute fast, reliable, and boring - in the best sense. When the clusters just work, research moves faster. Your impact is measured directly in training throughput and researcher velocity. This is a builder-operator role with real breadth: one week you're writing automation that eliminates a whole class of manual work, the next you're benchmarking a new provider's InfiniBand fabric or on-site bringing new hardware online. You'll have unusual scope and autonomy - we're a lean team where decisions are made by the people closest to the problem. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING - Operate and improve our GPU fleet end to end: provisioning, scheduling, monitoring, upgrades, capacity planning - Build automation that keeps the fleet healthy without human intervention — node health checks, automated draining and remediation, burn-in pipelines for new capacity - Own the stack beneath the training code: OS images, NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, container runtimes, NCCL, high-speed networking (InfiniBand/RoCE) - Run and tune job scheduling (Slurm or similar) so researchers get compute fairly and fast - Build and maintain high-performance storage for datasets and checkpoints - Hunt down performance problems: stragglers, degraded links, thermal issues, flaky GPUs — and fix the class of problem, not just the instance - Evaluate rented GPU capacity: benchmark it, validate it, hold providers to their SLAs - Hands-on hardware work when it's needed: racking, cabling, diagnostics, coordinating with datacenter staff and vendors - Keep clusters secure by default: access control, network isolation, secrets REQUIREMENTS - Have run large-scale Linux server or GPU environments in production and enjoy both building and operating - Know the NVIDIA stack well — drivers, CUDA, NCCL, DCGM — or have deep systems experience and learn hardware stacks fast - Are comfortable with bare-metal environments, server hardware, and high-speed networking - Write solid automation in Python and/or Bash, with IaC tools like Ansible or Terraform - Are happy digging into noisy data (metrics, logs, PromQL) to find what's actually wrong - Like owning real scope end to end and being the person others rely on - Don't consider any task above or beneath you — datacenter trips included NICE TO HAVE - Experience supporting ML training workloads from the infra side (distributed training failure modes, checkpointing patterns) - Experience evaluating and working with GPU cloud providers - Parallel filesystems (WEKA, VAST, etc) or large-scale object storage - BMC/IPMI/Redfish automation, PXE provisioning at scale - Power and cooling awareness for dense GPU deployments LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote #HPC-Infrastructure-Engineer-GPU-Clusters We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Partner closely with the Customer Service Operations Manager to improve service quality, operational consistency, employee capability and customer satisfaction. Own the Customer Operations learning approach, ensuring onboarding, continuous learning and development activities support operational priorities and business needs. Design, coordinate and continuously improve onboarding programmes that enable new employees to become confident and productive as quickly as possible. Develop and maintain structured learning pathways, training materials and knowledge resources that support employee development, career progression and readiness for new responsibilities. items.title: Manager, Applied AI Architects
items.description: About the Team The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. About the Role As the Manager of Applied AI Architects in Tokyo, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's largest and most complex customers across Japan. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact. You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will help prioritize customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth. You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between Japan strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching. In this role, you will: - Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, creating an environment of technical excellence, sound judgment, continuous learning, accountability, and strong customer stewardship. - Define and continuously refine the strategy and operating model for Applied AI Architecture across Japan, aligning company priorities with the evolving needs of strategic customers and the regional go-to-market. - Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritize accounts and opportunities, allocate technical resources effectively, and establish clear technical strategies for the region's most consequential engagements. - Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities. - Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production. - Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment. - Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed. - Mobilize Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience. - Establish a rigorous view of portfolio health, including technical wins, qualified use cases, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, measurable customer impact, and the technical contribution to growth. - Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Research, and go-to-market teams, while developing reusable architecture guidance and customer practices. - Foster a culture that balances ambitious customer outcomes with responsible AI deployment, clear ownership, thoughtful prioritization, and effective specialist handoffs. You might thrive in this role if you: - Possess deep technical acumen in modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, platform technologies, software and cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, identity, security, privacy, evaluation, and enterprise deployment. - Bring 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting, including work with large and complex enterprises. - Have 4+ years of people-management experience hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing technical teams. - Have guided enterprise organizations from technical discovery and evaluation through production adoption, healthy usage, and measurable business impact. - Demonstrate outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, boards, business leaders, and hands-on engineers. - Can lead a complex portfolio, make thoughtful resource-allocation decisions, and balance regional strategy with hands-on support for critical customer engagements. - Exercise strong architectural judgment, including knowing when to go deep personally, when to coach the team, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership. - Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Deployment, Customer Engagement, Security, Legal, Privacy, and external partner ecosystems. - Are comfortable leading across Japan from Tokyo and adapting your approach to different industries, cultures, regulatory contexts, and customer operating models. - Embody a customer-centric philosophy focused on durable value, responsible production adoption, technical excellence, and long-term partnership. - Approach your work with humility, curiosity, a collaborative spirit, and a deep commitment to the safe and beneficial advancement of AI. items.title: Product Delivery Manager
items.description: As a Product Delivery Manager , reporting to the Casino Backoffice and Regulatory Requirements Department Lead , you will play a key role in translating business, compliance, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable product requirements and ensuring their successful delivery. You will work on complex internal products and services where multiple initiatives, dependencies, and changing requirements need to be managed in parallel. You will be: Defining and shaping scope for initiatives, breaking down complex requirements into clear, actionable work for the development team. Planning and coordinating delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives, balancing priorities, dependencies, capacity, and business needs. Working closely with Compliance, Product, Technical Operations and other internal stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify expectations, and identify dependencies and risks early. Translating regulatory and compliance requirements into functional and technical requirements that can be understood, implemented, and tested by the development team. Ensuring a clear understanding of the product vision, scope, priorities, and requirements within the team, enabling effective day-to-day decision-making. Creating and maintaining the product backlog , ensuring it reflects functional, regulatory, compliance, and technical needs. Ensuring requirements are clear, complete, consistent, and testable , with appropriate acceptance criteria and consideration of edge cases. Owning and maintaining the product roadmap , aligning priorities and delivery expectations with stakeholders. Defining long-term, short-term, and daily priorities , adapting them as requirements, risks, or business priorities change. Identifying and managing cross-team dependencies, risks, and potential delivery blockers , ensuring they are addressed proactively. Driving the release and maintenance lifecycle of features and services, from initial requirement clarification through delivery and go-live. Ensuring that proposed changes are evaluated from the perspectives of usability, performance, maintainability, and regulatory compliance . Handling urgent issues and unexpected requests, helping the team and stakeholders assess impact, prioritize effectively, and reach timely decisions . Monitoring delivery progress and proactively communicating status, risks, dependencies, and changes in scope or priorities to relevant stakeholders. Cooperating with other Product Delivery Managers to continuously improve delivery practices, share knowledge, and build consistency across the department. To succeed in this role, you should have: At least 3 years of experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, Product Delivery Manager, Business Analyst, or in a similar role in a technology environment. Experience working with complex systems, configurations, business rules, and dependencies , with the ability to understand how changes in one area can affect others. Experience working with regulatory, compliance, or other requirements-driven environments is a strong advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills , with the ability to break down ambiguous or complex problems and turn them into practical solutions. A good understanding of how technical systems and integrations work , including APIs, databases, service layers, and interactions between systems. The ability to translate business and regulatory needs into clear functional requirements for technical teams. Experience with Agile methodologies , such as Scrum and Kanban. Strong prioritization and organizational skills , with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing requests simultaneously. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills , including the ability to clarify conflicting expectations and facilitate decisions. Strong English skills, both spoken and written. Strong attention to detail while maintaining the bigger-picture view of the product and delivery goals . Ability to adapt to changing requirements, and make pragmatic decisions when priorities shift. A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership, identify problems early, and drive them towards resolution .

About the Opportunity PayBox is one of MoonPay’s newest products. It enables people to transact directly through AI, connecting agents with payments, wallets and applications without requiring users to hand over their underlying credentials. We launched PayBox recently and saw strong initial traction. Now we’re building the next phase. There are multiple major product tracks underway: expanding PayBox across AI platforms, building peer-to-peer payment experiences, integrating with DeFi applications, growing our plugin ecosystem and significantly improving the end-to-end product experience. We’re looking for an exceptional Staff Software Engineer to help own PayBox and take it through this next stage. You’ll work closely with our Chief Engineer and a small, highly focused team. This is much closer to a founding engineer role than a traditional Staff engineering position. You’ll be expected to identify what matters, reason through difficult problems, make decisions and take areas of the product from idea through to production. That could mean designing and building an entirely new PayBox capability one week and obsessing over the details of an onboarding flow the next. We care equally about ambitious technical problems and the less glamorous work required to make a product great. We’re not looking for a specific technology or domain background. You don’t need previous crypto or MCP experience. We’re looking for an exceptional generalist engineer who can learn quickly, think independently, build end-to-end and deeply cares about what they ship. What You Will Do Own significant areas of PayBox end-to-end, from identifying the problem and defining the approach through to building, shipping and iterating in production. Help take a recently launched product through its next phase of 0→1 development and growth. Build new payment and peer-to-peer transfer experiences designed for AI interfaces. Build integrations across AI platforms, applications and the wider PayBox ecosystem. Help develop the infrastructure and product experiences required to bring new applications and integrations onto PayBox. Work closely with Product to turn ambitious ideas into simple, usable experiences. Sweat the details of the PayBox experience — particularly onboarding and UX — and fix the friction that prevents users from successfully using the product. Reason from first principles about difficult technical and product problems, making pragmatic decisions without waiting for perfect information. Move across different parts of the product and technical stack depending on where the highest-impact problem is. Use AI extensively to increase your speed and output while maintaining your own technical reasoning, judgement and attention to detail. About You We’re deliberately not defining the ideal candidate by a particular technology stack or domain. There are three things we care deeply about: technical ability, motivation and thoroughness. We’re looking for someone exceptional across all three. Must-have experience and skills Exceptional technical reasoning. You have strong engineering fundamentals and can break down unfamiliar, ambiguous problems and reason towards good solutions. High agency. You don’t wait for perfectly defined requirements or someone else to identify what needs doing. You find important problems and take responsibility for solving them. End-to-end ownership. You’ve built and shipped meaningful products, projects or systems from beginning to end rather than operating within a narrowly defined area. Thoroughness. You care deeply about the quality of your work and sweat details others might overlook. Getting something working is the beginning, not the end. Strong systems thinking. You can design systems, understand technical trade-offs and make sensible architectural decisions while moving quickly. Product judgement. You understand that great engineering includes the experience around the technology, not just the underlying implementation. Comfort with ambiguity. You’re at your best in environments where there are more problems than people and priorities can change quickly. Independent thinking in an AI-native environment. You use AI aggressively as a tool, but you don’t outsource your reasoning to it. You understand the output, challenge it and remain accountable for what you ship. Deep motivation. You want ownership and responsibility and care about the outcome of the product, not simply completing the work assigned to you. Nice-to-have experience Experience as a founding engineer or early engineer at a high-growth startup. Experience founding and building your own company or product. Experience taking a product from an idea through launch and subsequent iteration. Experience operating in small, highly autonomous engineering teams. Bonus Points Experience building AI-native products, agents or developer tooling. Experience with payments, fintech, crypto or DeFi. Previous experience with MCP or other emerging agent protocols. None of these are prerequisites. We care considerably more about how you think, what you’ve built, how you operate and how much you care about the quality of your work. Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot. As our remit expands across products including Ramps, Swaps, and Enterprise, the volume and complexity of product work is growing with it. You will take ownership of day-to-day product execution across our on-chain and off-chain workstreams, helping turn business and technical requirements into clearly defined, prioritised, and executable work. Working closely with the Principal Product Manager, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will support initiatives including liquidity-provider integrations, asset availability, routing and best-execution capabilities, custody and wallet infrastructure, and the broader on-chain services required to operate reliably at scale. Your work will help the team move faster, improve the efficiency and resilience of our liquidity infrastructure, and enable MoonPay to support significantly more products and transaction volume as the business grows. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, wants to deepen their understanding of crypto and financial infrastructure, and is excited to develop their product craft in a fast-moving, high-impact environment. What You Will Do Own day-to-day product execution across Crypto Asset Management initiatives, translating business, technical, operational, and compliance requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, project plans, and delivery milestones. Support integrations with new liquidity sources, including centralised exchanges, OTC trading desks, and decentralised services, helping expand MoonPay’s liquidity network and improve sourcing efficiency, reliability, and execution. Coordinate asset availability and infrastructure initiatives across Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Commercial, and other Product teams, ensuring dependencies, decisions, risks, and requirements are understood and tracked through delivery. Support the setup and evolution of technical infrastructure across areas such as wallets, gas sponsorship, transaction broadcasting, and other on-chain infrastructure services, working closely with engineering and operational teams to translate requirements into scalable product solutions. Support roadmap development and prioritisation, using data, commercial value, operational requirements, customer impact, risk, and engineering constraints to help determine which initiatives should be addressed first. Contribute to the evolution of our liquidity and asset-management infrastructure, including custody and wallet capabilities, liquidity routing, best execution, settlement efficiency, monitoring, and risk-management tooling. Use data to evaluate product performance and opportunities, identifying friction, operational inefficiencies, or areas where product and infrastructure improvements can create measurable value for MoonPay and its customers. You are comfortable working across cross-functional teams, particularly with Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, or Commercial stakeholders, and can turn complex or ambiguous requirements into clear actions and priorities. You have strong product thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to understand trade-offs, use data to support decisions, and prioritise work based on business and customer impact. You have a genuine interest in crypto, fintech, or financial infrastructure and are motivated to build a deeper understanding of areas such as blockchain networks, liquidity, exchanges, custody, wallets, and digital-asset infrastructure. Nice-to-have experience Previous exposure to crypto or fintech infrastructure, particularly liquidity management, exchange or OTC integrations, stablecoins, custody, wallets, or DeFi protocols. Bonus Points Familiarity with regulated financial products, crypto compliance requirements, blockchain infrastructure, or products handling high-value financial transactions. About the Opportunity As Deputy Treasurer you will report to the Treasurer, serving as their senior counterpart and shaping and executing MoonPay's treasury strategy as the business continues to scale. You will play a critical role across regulatory expansion, liquidity and capital management, treasury reporting, and trading-related activities. This is a high-impact role requiring strong financial judgment and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-moving environment. You will work across Finance and other key functions to ensure MoonPay has the liquidity, capital structure, controls, and treasury capabilities required to support its strategic ambitions and expansion into new markets. What you will do Partner closely with the Treasurer to develop and execute MoonPay's treasury strategy, translating company priorities into effective liquidity, capital, risk, and treasury plans. Lead liquidity and capital management activities, including forecasting requirements, optimizing deployment of capital, and identifying emerging constraints or opportunities. Support regulatory and geographic expansion by assessing treasury implications, capital and liquidity requirements, banking considerations, and relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., NYDFS trust company and payment stablecoin frameworks, GENIUS Act, FFIEC reporting, state money transmitter/BitLicense regimes). Oversee treasury analysis, scenario modelling, and reporting, translating liquidity, capital, and risk data into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. Provide senior oversight of trading-related treasury activities, including counterparty risk assessment across OTC and exchange trading relationships, applying disciplined risk management and financial analysis to decision-making, execution, and performance. Build scalable treasury infrastructure, controls, processes, and external partnerships that enable MoonPay to operate effectively as the business grows in scale and complexity. You have hands-on experience with digital asset treasury operations, including stablecoin reserve management, custody and wallet considerations, and exchange or on-chain counterparty risk. You bring advanced expertise in liquidity and capital management, treasury risk management, forecasting, and scenario analysis, with experience navigating complex and high-impact decisions. You have strong knowledge of financial regulation, particularly across banking, payments, money transmission, or digital asset and stablecoin frameworks, and experience evaluating the treasury implications of regulatory or market expansion. You have demonstrated the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders while operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, challenging assumptions, and building scalable approaches. items.title: Cilvēkresursu OPS biznesa partneris(-e)/ HR Business Partner for Operations
items.description: HR biznesa partneris Operacionālajā jomā, kas nodrošina visaptverošu personāla vadības atbalstu, stiprina organizācijas kultūru un atbalsta vadītājus efektīvu lēmumu pieņemšanā un komandu vadībā. Pienākumi: Darboties kā galvenajai HR kontaktpersonai Operacionālajās funkcijās, sniedzot praktisku atbalstu vadītājiem un veicinot efektīvu lēmumu pieņemšanu. Atbalstīt darbinieku iesaistes un organizācijas kultūras attīstības iniciatīvas. Nodrošināt kvalitatīvu darbinieka dzīves cikla procesu īstenošanu (atlase, ievadīšana darbā, attīstība, snieguma vadība, darba attiecību izbeigšana) un pilnveidot procesus. Konsultēt vadītājus darba tiesību un darba attiecību jautājumos, pārvaldīt sarežģītus gadījumus un nodrošināt atbilstību normatīvajiem aktiem. Analizēt personāla datus, identificēt riskus un sadarboties ar vadību darbaspēka plānošanā un noturēšanā. Sadarboties ar HR komandām un, pēc nepieciešamības, iesaistīties svarīgu amatu atlases procesos. Apmācīt un attīstīt vadītāju kompetences personāla vadībā un līderībā. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. Coach and mentor SEs to elevate technical depth, industry expertise, and consultative selling skills. Create development frameworks that build future leaders and promote internal mobility. Operational Excellence Design scalable regional SE frameworks to ensure consistency, excellence, and agility across APAC and MENA. Integrate AI, data-driven insights, and automation tools to enhance commercial deal support, forecasting, and solution quality. Partner with Revenue Operations to align coverage models, resource allocation, and pipeline analytics for the commercial segment. Drive regional alignment while respecting market nuance; balancing central efficiency with local agility. Strategic Partnerships & GTM Execution Collaborate with Commercial Sales Leadership to develop and execute account strategies for high-growth, multi-region customers. Partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver feedback loops that shape product innovation and roadmap alignment for the commercial market. Lead technical strategy for commercial segments verticals (e.g., retail, finance, SaaS, and E-commerce). Ensure Semrush’s commercial value proposition resonates through technical storytelling, business outcome framing, and stakeholder engagement. Customer Impact Guide your team in supporting high-value commercial deals through tailored demos, architecture reviews, and proof-of-concept initiatives. Serve as a regional technical sponsor for strategic commercial accounts, ensuring customer success from pre-sales through expansion. Champion adoption of AI-powered insights, automation, and data orchestration to deliver scalable and measurable impact for commercial clients. Promote regional consistency in how the SE team demonstrates ROI, TCO, and strategic value. Deep understanding of commercial sales cycles, procurement processes, and cross-functional stakeholder management. Experience in vertical markets (e.g., retail, finance, SaaS, and E-commerce). Strong command of AI and data-driven selling techniques, with demonstrated experience integrating tools that drive SE productivity and commercial customer engagement. Operational Rigor: Designs scalable, measurable systems that enable commercial growth and consistency. Empathetic Leadership: Builds high-trust, inclusive teams that thrive in virtual and multicultural environments. Technical and Commercial Acumen: Bridges deep product knowledge with customer business objectives. AI-Forward and Innovative: Champions new tools and technologies to accelerate outcomes. Influential Communicator: Inspires teams and customers through clarity, confidence, and authenticity. items.title: Virtual Events Manager
items.description: Perplexity is revolutionizing how companies get work done. We are seeking a Virtual Events Manager to build the channel that shows people what our products can do and teaches them how to use them. You will develop a deep working knowledge of our products, turn that knowledge into compelling live experiences, and own the programs that convert audiences into active users and qualified pipeline. This role has two sides. You are a charismatic host and product storyteller who can command a virtual room, and you are the operator who keeps every event on the rails. You will find and prepare the right experts from across Perplexity, work with Growth to build the audience, and measure whether each program produced a real business return. If you have a passion for understanding how things work, thrive in taking something complex and making it engaging, and want to build a world-class virtual events engine from the ground up, this role is for you. RESPONSIBILITIES - Know the product cold. Develop a deeper working knowledge of our products than anyone else in events, using new features as they ship, building the workflows yourself, and staying close to the teams that built them. - Own virtual events end to end. Run the channel from program strategy and calendar planning through event briefs, speaker staffing, rehearsals, live production, follow-up, and retros. Build a reliable portfolio of onboarding programs, product launches, feature deep-dives, customer conversations, and use-case workshops. - Bring the product to life. Host, moderate, present, and demonstrate the product live with energy and clarity. Turn complex capabilities into specific, accurate stories that audiences can understand and put to work. - Find and prepare the right people. Build relationships across Product, Engineering, Research, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Marketing to identify the strongest speakers and subject-matter experts for each program. Brief them thoroughly, sharpen their stories, and make sure they are ready to deliver. - Build the audience. Partner with Growth, Lifecycle, Social, Comms, Sales, and Customer Success on full-funnel promotion plans that drive qualified registrations. Track pacing closely, identify gaps early, and run experiments across audience, creative, channel mix, timing, and follow-up. - Turn every event into an engine. Extend the value of each program through recordings, replays, clips, FAQs, demo flows, education materials, and sales follow-up. Build formats and templates that make the next event faster and better. - Measure outcomes, not just outputs. Instrument the funnel from registration through attendance, engagement, product activation, qualified pipeline, and revenue. Track cost per registration, cost per attendee, cost per qualified attendee, sourced and influenced pipeline, and channel ROI, then use the findings to improve the portfolio. - Build the operating system. Create the intake process, master calendar, production checklists, run-of-show templates, speaker bench, readiness gates, contingency plans, scorecards, and reporting cadence required to scale the channel without lowering quality. QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of experience in virtual events, product marketing, customer education, demand generation, or a related role, ideally within a high-growth technology company, or work that proves the skill regardless of title. - Proven ability to learn technical products deeply and translate complex capabilities into simple, specific, and accurate live demonstrations. - A polished, credible on-camera presence, with experience hosting, interviewing, moderating, or presenting to professional audiences. - Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to find, recruit, brief, and coordinate busy experts without relying on formal authority. - Full-funnel growth fluency, including registration strategy, audience segmentation, campaign testing, conversion, and post-event nurture. - Analytical rigor, with experience defining channel metrics, working with CRM and marketing automation data, and calculating return on investment. - Excellent production judgment and attention to detail, including rehearsals, technical readiness, live moderation, and fallback planning. - High slope: you learn unfamiliar products and domains fast, and your rate of improvement is your standout trait. - Extreme comfort delivering clarity in high-velocity, ambiguous environments.

Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Payward is hiring a HR (People) M&A Lead to own the people side of our M&A activity end to end — from first-pass diligence through close and integration. Reporting directly to our CPO, this is a high-pace, high-volume seat that needs someone who thrives on fast turnarounds and incomplete information. We're looking for an in-house operator with an analyst's mindset who can use AI to move fast through messy data rooms, but whose real edge is judgment — knowing what risks matter and when to deviate. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the people's workstream of Payward's M&A activity end to end — from first-pass diligence through close and integration. - Build and own People due diligence questionnaire (DDQ) including data requests and questions to the target, follow-ups and deeper-dive workshops. - Crunch high-volume, low-structure data rooms — employment contracts, org data, comp and equity files, policies, claims history — using AI and automation to compress review cycles. - Filter signal from noise: translate hundreds of findings into a short list of flags scored against Payward's risk tolerance, with a clear recommendation attached to each. - Lead the drafting of the people-side deal mechanics: comp modelling, equity treatment, retention and earn-out structures, and deal-specific considerations that hold up in negotiation with founders. - Sit in the room with corp dev, legal, finance and People leadership — leverage SMEs and push recommendations upward, defending them with data. - Act as People M&A program manager during integration after signing: support org design, levelling and comp harmonization, retention execution, and Day 1 people readiness. - Turn each deal into reusable infrastructure and learnings — playbooks, DDQ templates, risk scoring, and automation that make the next deal faster. WHAT YOU BRING - 8+ years across M&A people/HR diligence, integration, total rewards, or corp dev — with hands-on ownership of the people workstream on completed deals. - A track record of running multi-diligence processes in tandem, to a hard timeline: knowing what to prioritize or defer. - Strong analytical depth — comfortable modelling comp, equity, dilution, retention cost and integration spend directly, not briefing someone else to do it. - Global/cross-border deal experience with multi-jurisdiction and/or regulatory change of control employment considerations. - Demonstrated use of AI and automation to review large document volumes, with judgement about where the model's output can and cannot be trusted. - Ability to make and communicate risk calls on incomplete information, and to state a position clearly to executive stakeholders. - Credibility in founder-facing negotiation conversations on comp, equity and retention structures. - Rigorous confidentiality instincts and comfort operating on live, undisclosed transactions. - High agency in ambiguity — deals move, scope shifts, and no one hands over a finished process. NICE TO HAVES - Crypto, fintech or regulated financial services acquisition experience. - Experience integrating founder-led or early-stage teams into a larger platform. - Prior work building a diligence or integration playbook from scratch. items.title: Manager, Technical & Operational Accounting
items.description: About the Team OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission. The Technical Accounting, Accounting Policy, and Financial Reporting organization partners across Finance to assess complex corporate matters and develop well-supported U.S. GAAP conclusions. The team supports non-routine business activities requiring thoughtful technical judgment, scalable accounting policies, financial statement disclosures, processes, and controls. About the Role You will partner closely with Technical Accounting, Financial Reporting and Controllership to translate complex accounting conclusions into scalable operational procedures. You will build processes for non-standard transactions, including warrants, equity-method investments, debt and equity securities, non-controlling interests, hypothetical liquidation at book value allocations, business combinations, and other complex financing, investment, and capital arrangements. You will advise stakeholders across Corporate Accounting, Financial Reporting, Treasury, Legal, Tax, Strategic Finance, FP&A, Equity, Internal Controls, valuation specialists, and external auditors. You will help resolve complex accounting questions, align leaders on material judgments and risks, and translate conclusions into audit-ready memoranda, close entries, disclosures, processes, and controls. This is a highly visible role for an accounting professional who can turn technical conclusions into practical execution, support non-routine transactions through recurring close processes, and strengthen operational accounting across Finance. In this role, you will: - Own operational accounting for complex financing, investment, equity, and capital arrangements, including classification, measurement, presentation, disclosure, and recurring close processes. - In partnership with technical accounting, lead day-one and recurring accounting for non-standard transactions, including fair-value measurements, equity-method investments, debt and equity securities, warrants, noncontrolling interests, and hypothetical liquidation at book value allocations. - Perform reconciliations for assigned accounts, investigate discrepancies, and drive issues to resolution. - Support the resolution of complex accounting matters during monthly and quarterly close. Ensure conclusions are reflected in financial statement presentation, footnote disclosures, journal entries, reconciliations, ownership, and controls. - Build operational processes to assess impairment indicators and asset recoverability for goodwill, intangible assets, long-lived asset groups, equity-method investments, nonmarketable equity investments, and debt securities, as applicable. - Coordinate valuations for non-standard transactions with Technical Accounting and valuation specialists. - Lead audit support for assigned investments and other complex accounting areas. Prepare evidence-backed schedules, memoranda, reconciliations, valuation support, and financial statement tie-outs. - Analyze significant equity and other compensation awards, and partner with Equity Administration and Controllership to ensure accurate, timely accounting and booking. - Coordinate with Tax on downstream impacts without owning tax conclusions. - Partner with Financial Reporting and Internal Controls to strengthen controls, SOX/ICFR readiness, impairment monitoring, audit trails, tie-outs, and subsequent-event procedures. - Monitor emerging accounting standards and translate new guidance into policies, implementation plans, disclosures, reporting calendars, and scalable processes. - Participate in cross-functional initiatives involving accounting-policy implementation, operating-model changes, legal-entity matters, and systems or process improvements. - Develop pragmatic accounting policies, playbooks, decision frameworks, and automation that improve consistency, strengthen capability, preserve judgment, reflect economic substance, and escalate unresolved issues. You might thrive in this role if you: - Hold a CPA, CA, or equivalent accounting qualification, or bring comparable demonstrated technical-accounting expertise. - Bring 5+ years of progressive experience in technical accounting, accounting advisory, public accounting, corporate controllership, or complex financial reporting, with meaningful industry or transaction experience. - Demonstrate broad U.S. GAAP expertise across corporate accounting, financial instruments, consolidation, business combinations, equity-method investments, debt and equity securities, impairment, fair value, financial statement presentation, and complex ownership structures. - Apply relevant guidance across ASC 320, 321, 323 326, 350, 360, 470, 480, 718, 805, 810, 815, and 820; and other applicable guidance as the facts require. - Have developed or reviewed audit-ready technical memoranda, implemented conclusions in recurring operations, worked constructively with external auditors, and grounded conclusions in evidence, economic substance, and authoritative guidance. - Have experience with significant aspects of close and reporting, acquisitions or investments, complex ownership structures, consolidation, or impairment assessments. Understand how technical decisions affect journal entries, reconciliations, disclosures, and controls. - Understand how accounting policies and judgments flow into close, financial statements, disclosures, reconciliations, significant estimates, treasury activity, and external-reporting readiness. - Set priorities across consequential workstreams and raise the bar for inclusive, scalable accounting practices while protecting financial reporting integrity. - Have experience with Oracle Fusion Accounting Hub, accounting rules engines, automated subledgers, ERP implementations, or similar source-to-general-ledger systems. items.title: Field Marketing Manager
items.description: Great products grow when people experience their value firsthand. We are looking for a Field Marketing Manager to design and scale programs that turn in-person engagement into enterprise pipeline. You will manage a full range of third-party sponsorships and Perplexity-led field events that drive awareness, deepen relationships with senior buyers, and accelerate opportunities. You will join a small field marketing team as an equal partner, working together to divide the portfolio based on company priorities, capacity, geography, and each person's strengths. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the strategy and execute every detail. You will work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Growth, Partnerships, and Customer Success to identify the right audiences, build programs around their needs, and turn each event into measurable business impact. The ideal candidate is a field marketing generalist who is equally comfortable evaluating a sponsorship, building a regional plan, hosting an executive dinner, working a conference floor, and analyzing pipeline conversion afterward. You may bring deeper experience in sponsored events or owned programs, but you should be ready to operate across both. RESPONSIBILITIES - Co-own the field marketing strategy. Work as an equal partner on a two-person field marketing team to build the portfolio around company priorities, target accounts, sales territories, product launches, and pipeline goals. Divide and conquer across programs while maintaining shared standards, visibility, and accountability. - Turn field engagement into pipeline. Design every program around a clear audience, business objective, conversion path, and follow-up plan, from pre-event outreach through opportunity creation and deal acceleration. - Own third-party event sponsorships. Evaluate conferences and sponsorship opportunities, recommend where Perplexity should invest, negotiate and activate packages, coordinate speakers and on-site presence, and build the pre-event and post-event motion required to produce a return. - Run high-impact Perplexity events. Own executive dinners, vertical roundtables, regional roadshows, customer workshops, and hackathons that build pipeline and deepen relationships with senior buyers. - Align tightly with Sales. Partner with Account Executives, SDRs, and Sales leadership on target-account lists, meeting goals, outreach, on-site roles, hand-raiser routing, and post-event follow-up. - Represent Perplexity in the market. Lead on-site execution across conferences and owned events, including messaging, booth or venue experience, executive participation, customer meetings, and post-event conversion. - Build integrated campaigns around field moments. Work with Product Marketing, Growth, Lifecycle, Social, Comms, and Partnerships to extend events through targeted outreach, content, digital programs, and sales activation before and after each moment. - Own execution end to end. Manage agencies, vendors, venues, budgets, timelines, run-of-show, staffing, production, and contingency planning while maintaining a high bar for attendee experience. - Measure outcomes, not activity. Instrument the path from invited account through registration, attendance, meeting, opportunity, and revenue. Track cost per attendee, meetings held, target-account engagement, sourced and influenced pipeline, deal acceleration, and program ROI. - Build the field operating system. Create the planning cadence, intake process, event tiers, checklists, reporting, and retros required to scale the program and make investment decisions based on results. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of experience in field marketing and event marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. - Proven track record building and scaling a portfolio that includes third-party sponsorships, conferences, and company-led field programs, with measurable pipeline or deal-acceleration results. - A versatile, hands-on operator who can move between strategy, sponsorship evaluation, campaign planning, event production, executive management, on-site execution, and performance analysis. - Deep expertise in either third-party sponsorships or company-led field events is welcome, provided you have the range and interest to operate across both. - Strong event planning and execution skills, with experience managing both intimate executive programs and larger conferences, roadshows, or customer events. - Collaborative and low-ego, with experience working alongside a peer to divide a large portfolio, make tradeoffs, share context, and step into each other's programs when needed. - Excellent relationship builder who can engage senior executives, customers, prospects, Sales teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners with equal ease. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling event narratives, executive briefs, and field campaign plans. - Analytically rigorous, with experience setting targets, managing budgets, working with CRM data, and reporting sourced and influenced pipeline. - Highly organized, resourceful, and calm under pressure, with the judgment to solve problems quickly when plans change on site. - Willingness to travel frequently for event management and field activations.
